packageRules.description: Automatically merge non-major and digest updates once required checks pass

Keep the golang tag in tailscale/Dockerfile and the org.opencontainers.image.base.name label in docker-bake.hcl in one pull request. They describe the same image and build_test.sh fails when they disagree.

customManagers.description: Track HADRON_VERSION (the Hadron base image tag used by every layer's test stage) via GHCR. Bumping this triggers a full rebuild across all layers, which is exactly the smoke test we want on every new Hadron release.

Track the golang tag the tailscale layer is labelled with. The Dockerfile FROM is bumped by the built-in dockerfile manager; nothing else looks inside docker-bake.hcl, so without this the label falls behind on every Go patch release (kairos-io/kairos#5407).
